p.span: The AI for Work course is designed to help professionals harness the power of Artificial Intelligence to work smarter, faster, and more creatively. Through a combination of hands-on exercises, real-world examples, and ready-to-use templates, participants will learn how to integrate AI into everyday workflows to enhance productivity and problem-solving.

The course introduces tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Microsoft Copilot, offering practical guidance on how to craft effective prompts, automate repetitive tasks, and generate insightful, high-quality outputs. By the end, learners will be equipped with the confidence and competence to use AI responsibly and strategically across different professional functions.

li.span: Business professionals looking to improve efficiency and productivity.
Managers and team leaders seeking to streamline workflows and decision-making.
Anyone interested in using AI to simplify everyday work tasks.

div.p: By leveraging AI prompting techniques, you will learn how to:

ul.li: Save time by automating routine tasks and communications.
Extract insights from data and turn them into actionable strategies.
Simplify complex projects by breaking them into manageable steps.
Enhance creativity when drafting content, presentations, or business materials.
Use AI responsibly, maintaining accuracy, transparency, and ethical integrity.

div.p: By the end of this course, participants will be able to:

ul.li: Draft professional email campaigns and communications using AI tools.
Create trackers and reports to monitor business or project progress.
Generate presentations and summaries from raw information or data.
Develop and refine AI prompts for consistent, high-quality results.
Integrate AI applications into daily workflows to improve efficiency and decision-making.

p.span: Venue: The FLOW Academy, No. 22 Level 1, Triq Wenzu Dyer, Hamrun. Malta.
